Q5012.reason: Muscle glucose uptake is by GLUT4 facilitated diffusion; insulin is not always required (exercise also translocates GLUT4), hexokinase phosphorylates glucose after entry, and MCTs carry monocarboxylates not glucose.

Q5013.reason: Baroreceptors in the carotid sinus and aortic arch sense stretch from blood-pressure changes; chemoreceptors sense blood gases, and the vasomotor/cardiovascular centres integrate rather than detect the signal.

Q5014.reason: In eukaryotic cells, DNA is transcribed to mRNA in the nucleus; ribosomes and the cytosol are sites of translation, and transcription is not limited to cell division.
